behavior: A checkbox takes its place in the value of a `CheckboxGroup` from its `value` prop only. A checkbox with no `value` is not an item of the group: it keeps its own checked state, and the group value does not change with it. In a native form, the checkboxes of a group share one `name`, and `value` tells them apart, so a `name` cannot be the value of an item. Base UI uses the `name` of a checkbox with no `value` as its value in the group.
